data: What is the percentage of the blue line for source sentence lengths between 30 and 40 words?

The blue line represents the number of search errors under Beam-10 with empty global bests. The x-axis shows the source sentence length in intervals of 10 words, ranging from 0 to 60 words. The y-axis shows the percentage of search errors.

To determine the percentage of the blue line for source sentence lengths between 30 and 40 words, we need to look at the portion of the blue line corresponding to this interval on the x-axis. From the graph, the blue line reaches approximately 80% at the point where the x-axis value is 40. Therefore, the percentage of the blue line for source sentence lengths between 30 and 40 words is around 80%.
